watches.name: LIBERUM RE-XHAUST
watches.description: The RE-XHAUST collection represents more than just a product launch: it is a declaration of intent towards responsible production, durable design and materials with a real history. The goal is to create watches that don't just follow trends, but are designed to last and accompany the wearer, becoming part of their identity. The watch is MADE IN ITALY , assembled and produced in Italy with a case machined from solid using CNC technology . The project will be launched soon and promises to introduce a new way of thinking about materials in watchmaking, combining Italian engineering, sustainable innovation, and a passion for mechanics. Technical Specifications : Diameter: 38mm Tickness: 9,8mm (glass included) Lug to lug: 46 mm Movement: Miyota 9015 Automatic with laser processing Water Resistance: 100M Glass: Sapphire anti-reflective Dial: Sapphire smoked painted Lume: Superluminova BGW) Crown : Steel screw 316L Case: Steel 316L grade 1.4441 (Recycled Solar Steel) Case back: Steel screw 316L Strap: Delcro Nylon by DELUGS 2 YEAR WARRANTY * You are purchasing the pre-order, the product will ship in September 2026, you will be informed of the progress of the production

watches.name: LIBERUM - FULL LUME DIAL
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION: The NEW dial with its highlithed index outline and full luminescence, Full Lume C1 SUPERLUMINOVA GL dial provides a bright green glow upon exposure to light, allowing for perfect reading of the time even in pitch darkness. During the day, the light finish of the luminous dial can create a clean, elegant yet modern, almost monochromatic look for a clean, all-white effect. We listened to the community and decided it was time to release a model with a full lume dial, and now it's yours! To offer even more combination options, we've paired it with satin and NATURAL and BLACK ALUMINIUM cases. Included you will find an aluminum case, two straps of your choice and a colored TPE case (*while stocks last, a random color will be added, message us to get your favorite) Limited edition of 15 pieces , with anodized aluminium case, machined from solid with CNC technique. In addition to your chosen aluminum case, you will also receive a TPE case and its high-resistance polyurethane strap in the color of your choice. Automatic NH35 movement Full Lume Dial SUPERLUMINOVA GL Series (C1) Sapphire glass treated with anti-reflective coating, Screw back Screw crown WR 100 meters (10 ATM). * If you want to add another strap beyond the one you chose, return to the store to the straps section. 1 YEAR WARRANTY

watches.name: LIBERUM X PMH DOODLE
watches.description: PMH Artist is a French artist who has developed his own style of scribbles. His patterns intertwine, like “graphic ivy”, and take over the space. In the age of virtual connections, the artist PMH reminds us of the importance of concrete, real and authentic connections between us. His works aim to create true harmony between people. He has created a limited edition dial (20 pieces) for LIBERUM® , signed the case back and created a painting with all the boxes of the series, truly amazing. Now you can wear his unique art on your wrist! You will be connected to other customers in a unique work, @pmhdoodle has composed a single drawing using the 20 limited series boxes, what a GENIUS!!! Limited edition of 20 pieces , with anodized aluminium case, machined from solid with CNC technique. In addition to your chosen aluminum case, you will also receive a TPE case and its high-resistance polyurethane strap in the color of your choice.
